question: The main temple of Shri Jagannath is an impressive and amazing structure constructed in Kalinga architecture, with a height of ____ meters placed on an elevated platform.
solution:
The correct answer is __**65 meters**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Shri Jagannath Temple** is located in **Puri, Odisha**, and is one of the **Char Dham** pilgrimage sites of Hinduism.
 
• The main temple is an outstanding example of **Kalinga architecture**.
 
• The temple's main shrine (**Vimana/Deula**) rises to a height of approximately **65 meters (214 feet)** and stands on an elevated stone platform.
 
• The temple was built during the reign of **Anantavarman Chodaganga Deva** of the Eastern Ganga dynasty in the 12th century CE, with later additions by his successors.
 
• At the summit of the temple is the **Nilachakra**, an eight-spoked wheel made of an alloy of eight metals (*Ashtadhatu*).
 
• Hence, the correct answer is **Option 2 – 65 meters**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Location:** Puri, Odisha.
 
• **Presiding Deities:**
 
 
• Lord Jagannath
 
• Lord Balabhadra
 
• Goddess Subhadra
 
 
 
• **Architectural Style:** Kalinga architecture (Rekha Deula style).
 
• **Famous Festival:** The annual **Rath Yatra (Chariot Festival)**, celebrated with great devotion and attended by millions of pilgrims.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Temple Height:** **65 meters (214 feet)**.
 
• **Location:** **Puri, Odisha**.
 
• **Architecture:** **Kalinga architecture**.
 
• **Builder:** **Anantavarman Chodaganga Deva** (Eastern Ganga dynasty).
 
• **Special Feature:** The **Nilachakra** crowns the temple's main spire.
